_about: Public-domain Johannes Baptist Alzog (1808-1878, Freiburg church historian) in English for the Word Hoard: the Manual of Universal Church History, tr. F. J. Pabisch and Thomas S. Byrne (3 vols, Cincinnati: Robert Clarke, 1874-1878), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
